00337     std::string supportedStandardSampleRates (

00339         const PaStreamParameters *outputParameters) {
00340         double standardSampleRates[] = {
00341             8000.0, 9600.0, 11025.0, 12000.0, 16000.0, 22050.0, 24000.0, 32000.0,
00342             44100.0, 48000.0, 88200.0, 96000.0, 192000.0, -1
00343         };
00344         std::stringstream s;
00345 
00346         PaError err;
00347         int printCount = 0;
00348         for (int i = 0; standardSampleRates[i] > 0; i++) {
00349             err = Pa_IsFormatSupported (inputParameters, outputParameters, 
00350                 standardSampleRates[i]);
00351             if (err == paFormatIsSupported) {
00352                 if (printCount == 0) {
00353                     s << " " << standardSampleRates[i];
00354                     printCount = 1;
00355                 }
00356                 else if (printCount == 4) {
00357                     s << ",\n " << standardSampleRates[i];
00358                     printCount = 1;
00359                 }
00360                 else {
00361                     s << ", " << standardSampleRates[i];
00362                     ++printCount;
00363                 }
00364             }
00365         }
00366         if (!printCount)
00367             s << "\tNone\n";
00368         else
00369             s << "\n";
